bundle.shortDescription: Local code context and memory for every AI tool
bundle.longDescription: Synapse indexes your repositories on your own machine — definitions, a reference-ranked repo map, keyword and local-embedding search — and serves that context to the Builderforce VS Code extension, Claude Code, Cursor and any MCP client. Nothing leaves the machine.
